old_caption: The video showcases a tall stack of wooden blocks, arranged vertically against a completely black background. The blocks are uniformly stacked, creating a rectangular column. Flames are already present at the bottom of the stack and are actively burning upwards. The fire is dynamic, with the flames flickering and dancing. The black background provides a stark contrast, making the flames stand out vividly. There are no other objects or characters present in the scene, and the focus remains solely on the burning stack of blocks.
original_wisa_caption: The video showcases a tall stack of wooden blocks, arranged vertically against a completely black background. The blocks are uniformly stacked, creating a rectangular column. As the video progresses, flames begin to appear at the bottom of the stack, starting from the base and gradually spreading upwards. The fire is dynamic, with the flames flickering and dancing, casting a warm, orange glow on the surrounding area. The intensity of the flames increases slightly over time, indicating an ongoing burning process. The black background provides a stark contrast, making the flames stand out vividly. There are no other objects or characters present in the scene, and the focus remains solely on the burning stack of blocks. The camera angle is fixed throughout the video, maintaining a consistent view of the burning structure without any noticeable movement or change in perspective.
caption: The video showcases a vertical rectangular brick column centered against a pure black background, with orange flames active across its front face. A thin, wavy flame trail runs down the brick surface, continuously morphing and shifting laterally rather than translating as a rigid shape, changing thickness and brightness frame to frame. Above the top edge, a larger flickering plume rises and deforms, sometimes tall and branching, sometimes curling into an arc, yet it persists without appearing or vanishing. Two short flame tongues sit at the bottom, flickering in height and intensity while remaining present. The brick column stays fixed in position and size throughout. The viewpoint holds steady, with the bricks and black background remaining stationary. The visible motion is confined to the flame shapes, which undulate and pulse against the unchanging masonry, the fire still burning.
